name: Spouse Abandonment
overview: Scripture presents marriage as a sacred covenant where a man and woman become one flesh, emphasizing faithfulness and unity (Genesis 2:24). The Lord expresses strong disapproval of putting away a spouse, equating it with treachery and violence (Malachi 2:16). Jesus teaches that divorcing one's spouse, except in the case of sexual immorality, leads to adultery both for the one who divorces and for anyone who marries the divorced person (Matthew 5:32; 19:9; Mark 10:12; Luke 16:18). This underscores the seriousness of spouse abandonment and the call to uphold marital fidelity as God’s design.
